items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: Billie Holiday, that was the last time I saw her alive. Billie came in and she looked so bad, but she came over to me and says, baby, I don't feel so good

ctx.x: That is only one of the things that hurt me, I was unable to do anything for Billie Holiday.
I forgot to tell you about the birthday party they gave to me at Birdland.
